sql.attachmentType.getTypesForCompany: select at.*, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where company_id = :companyId and at.archived is not true and at.is_system is not true
sql.attachmentType.getAllUsingType: select concat('Process Step: ', ps.process_step_name) as process_step_name from flow.process_step_attachment_type at inner join flow.process_step ps on at.process_step_id = ps.id where at.attachment_type_id = :typeId and at.archived is false and ps.archived is false union select concat('Event: ', e.event_name) as process_step_name from flow.event_attachment_type at inner join flow.event e on at.event_id = e.id where at.attachment_type_id = :typeId and at.archived is false and e.archived is false union select 'Project' as process_step_name from flow.project_attachment_type at where at.attachment_type_id = :typeId and at.archived is false union select ot.object_type as process_step_name from flow.company_object_type_attachment_type cotat inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cotat.company_object_type_id = cot.id inner join flow.object_type ot on cot.object_type_id = ot.id where cotat.attachment_type_id = :typeId and cotat.archived is false order by process_step_name
sql.attachmentType.getSystemTypes: select at.*, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where at.archived is not true and at.is_system is true order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getObjectType: SELECT cotat.id, cotat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", cotat.created_by_id as "createdById", cotat.company_object_type_id as "companyObjectTypeId", cotat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cotat.display_order as "displayOrder", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", cotat.archived FROM flow.company_object_type_attachment_type cotat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = cotat.attachment_type_id where cotat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateTypeOrderInObjectTy: update flow.company_object_type_attachment_type set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertObjectType: insert into flow.company_object_type_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, company_object_type_id, display_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:attachmentTypeId, :companyObjectTypeId, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.company_object_type_attachment_type where company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId and archived is not true), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.getObjectTypes: SELECT cotat.id, cotat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", cotat.created_by_id as "createdById", cotat.company_object_type_id as "companyObjectTypeId", cotat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", cotat.display_order as "displayOrder", cotat.archived FROM flow.company_object_type_attachment_type cotat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = cotat.attachment_type_id where cotat.company_object_type_id = :companyObjectTypeId and cotat.archived is not true order by cotat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.deleteObjectType: update flow.company_object_type_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getAvailableTypesForObjec: select at.* from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select company_object_type_id from flow.company_object_type_attachment_type cotat where cotat.attachment_type_id = at.id and cotat.company_object_type_id = :id and archived is not true and at.is_system is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getAvailableTypesForProce: select at.* from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select process_step_id from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat where psat.attachment_type_id = at.id and psat.process_step_id = :id and archived is not true and at.is_system is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getAttachmentTypesForProj: select at.*, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where company_id = :companyId and at.archived is not true and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select id from flow.project_attachment_type pat where pat.attachment_type_id = at.id and pat.archived is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getProcessStepType: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.process_step_id as "processStepId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", psat.display_order as "displayOrder", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.archived FROM flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertProcessStepType: insert into flow.process_step_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, process_step_id, display_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:attachmentTypeId, :processStepId, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.process_step_attachment_type where process_step_id = :processStepId and archived is not true), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.deleteProcessStepType: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getType: select at.id, at.attachment_type, at.company_id, at.archived, at.key_pattern_id, kp.key_pattern from flow.attachment_type at inner join flow.key_pattern kp on kp.id = at.key_pattern_id where at.company_id = :companyId and at.id = :typeId order by at.attachment_type;
sql.attachmentType.deleteType: update flow.attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateType: update flow.attachment_type set attachment_type = :attachmentType, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertType: insert into flow.attachment_type(attachment_type, company_id, key_pattern_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:attachmentType, :companyId, :keyPatternId, :createdById, now(), :createdById, now()) returning id;
sql.attachmentType.getProjectType: SELECT psat.id, psat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", psat.created_by_id as "createdById", psat.company_id as "companyId", psat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", psat.display_order as "displayOrder", psat.archived FROM flow.project_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getProjectTypes: SELECT pat.id, pat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", pat.created_by_id as "createdById", pat.company_id as "companyId", pat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", pat.display_order as "displayOrder", pat.archived, case when (select psat.id from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.process_step ps on psat.process_step_id = ps.id where psat.attachment_type_id = pat.attachment_type_id and psat.archived is false and ps.archived is false limit 1 ) is null then false else true end as "includesPsType", pat.read_only FROM flow.project_attachment_type pat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = pat.attachment_type_id where pat.company_id = :companyId and pat.archived is not true order by pat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.insertProjectType: insert into flow.project_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, company_id, display_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:attachmentTypeId, :companyId, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.project_attachment_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.deleteProjectType: update flow.project_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getProcessStepTypes: select psat.id, at.attachment_type, psat.attachment_type_id, psat.process_step_id, psat.date_created, psat.date_modified, psat.created_by_id, psat.modified_by_id, psat.archived from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.process_step_id = :processStepId and psat.archived is not true order by psat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.getProcessStepTypesByPps: select psat.id, at.attachment_type, psat.attachment_type_id, psat.process_step_id, psat.date_created, psat.date_modified, psat.created_by_id, psat.modified_by_id, psat.archived from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.id = :ppsId and pps.process_step_id = psat.process_step_id inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where pps.project_id = :projectId and psat.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId order by psat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.updateTypeOrderInProcessS: update flow.process_step_attachment_type set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateTypeOrderInProject: update flow.project_attachment_type set display_order = :displayOrder, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.updateReadyOnly: update flow.project_attachment_type set read_only = :readOnly, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.attachmentType.getEventTypes: select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id where eat.event_id = :eventId and eat.archived is not true order by eat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.getEventTypesByPpsEventId: select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id inner join flow.event e on eat.event_id = e.id inner join flow.process_step_event pse on e.id = pse.event_id inner join flow.project_process_step_event ppse on pse.id = ppse.process_step_event_id and ppse.id = :ppsEventId where eat.archived is not true order by eat.display_order

select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id inner join flow.event e on eat.event_id = e.id inner join flow.process_step_event pse on e.id = pse.event_id inner join flow.project_process_step_event ppse on pse.id = ppse.process_step_event_id and ppse.id = :ppsEventId inner join flow.project_process_step pps on ppse.project_process_step_id = pps.id and pps.id = :ppsId and pps.project_id = :projectId where eat.archived is not true order by eat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.getEventTypes: select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id where eat.event_id = :eventId and eat.archived is not true order by eat.display_order
sql.attachmentType.getEventAndPsTypes: select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, null::int as process_step_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived, eat.display_order from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id where eat.event_id = :eventId and eat.archived is not true union all select psat.id, at.attachment_type, psat.attachment_type_id, null::int as event_id, psat.process_step_id, psat.date_created, psat.date_modified, psat.created_by_id, psat.modified_by_id, psat.archived, psat.display_order from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id where psat.process_step_id = :processStepId and psat.archived is not true order by display_order
sql.attachmentType.getEventAndPsTypesByPpsEv: with details as ( select pse.process_step_id, pse.event_id from flow.project_process_step_event ppse inner join flow.process_step_event pse on ppse.process_step_event_id = pse.id where ppse.id = :ppsEventId ) select eat.id, at.attachment_type, eat.attachment_type_id, eat.event_id, null::int as process_step_id, eat.date_created, eat.date_modified, eat.created_by_id, eat.modified_by_id, eat.archived, eat.display_order from flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id inner join details d on d.event_id = eat.event_id where eat.archived is not true union all select psat.id, at.attachment_type, psat.attachment_type_id, null::int as event_id, psat.process_step_id, psat.date_created, psat.date_modified, psat.created_by_id, psat.modified_by_id, psat.archived, psat.display_order from flow.process_step_attachment_type psat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = psat.attachment_type_id inner join details d on d.process_step_id = psat.process_step_id where psat.archived is not true order by display_order
sql.attachmentType.getAvailableTypesForEvent: select at.* from flow.attachment_type at where at.archived is not true and at.company_id = :companyId and at.is_system is not true and not exists ( select event_id from flow.event_attachment_type eat where eat.attachment_type_id = at.id and eat.event_id = :id and eat.archived is not true and at.is_system is not true ) order by at.attachment_type
sql.attachmentType.getEventType: SELECT eat.id, eat.attachment_type_id as "attachmentTypeId", eat.created_by_id as "createdById", eat.event_id as "eventId", eat.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", eat.display_order as "displayOrder", at.attachment_type as "attachmentType", eat.archived FROM flow.event_attachment_type eat inner join flow.attachment_type at on at.id = eat.attachment_type_id where eat.id = :id
sql.attachmentType.insertEventType: insert into flow.event_attachment_type (attachment_type_id, event_id, display_order, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:attachmentTypeId, :eventId, (select coalesce(max(display_order) + 1, 0) from flow.event_attachment_type where event_id = :eventId and archived is not true), :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.attachmentType.deleteEventType: update flow.event_attachment_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
